tracks.title: Hold The Line Open
tracks.subject: a long-distance call
tracks.caption: An indie rock band recorded live in one room — drums, bass and two electric guitars, one clean and arpeggiated, one with light overdrive. A raspy male voice sings close-miked and conversational in the verses and pushes into a shout on the chorus. Bone-dry drums with audible room bleed, no reverb on the vocal, tape saturation on the bus. Driving, 132 BPM, E minor. Urgent, unresolved.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Guitars]

[Verse 1]
Eight hours and a bad connection
You say my name and then it cuts
I hold the phone against the window
Like the glass could help somehow

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't hang up yet
Don't hang up yet

[Chorus]
Hold the line open
Even if there's nothing on it
I'd rather hear you breathing wrong
Than hear the room without you in it

[Verse 2]
You're asleep before my morning
I'm asleep before your night
We trade the same four hours over
Like they're all we're allowed

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
I counted every time it dropped
I stopped at forty-one
I kept redialing anyway

[Chorus]
Hold the line open
Even if there's nothing on it
I'd rather hear you breathing wrong
Than hear the room without you in it

[Outro]
Still here
Still here

tracks.title: Lampu Kedai Tutup
tracks.subject: closing up a roadside shop
tracks.caption: Malaysian slow rock — rock kapak. A four-piece band: heavy slow backbeat, a bass that walks under the chorus, a clean rhythm guitar and a lead guitar that answers every vocal line and takes a long melodic solo. A male tenor sings with a wide vibrato and belts the chorus at full voice, the way 90s Malaysian slow rock ballads do. Tape saturation, close-miked vocals, plate reverb on the guitars. Slow and heavy, 74 BPM, A minor.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Lead Guitar]

[Verse 1]
Lampu kedai sudah kupadam
Kerusi terbalik di atas meja
Jalan ini sunyi jam tiga pagi
Hanya aku dan bayang sendiri

[Pre-Chorus]
Dua puluh tahun aku di sini
Hari ini hari terakhir

[Chorus]
Biar gelap, aku tak lari
Biar habis, aku tak menyesal
Setiap pinggan yang pernah kubasuh
Ada nama anak-anakku di situ

[Verse 2]
Orang kata zaman dah berubah
Kedai baru buka depan sana
Aku tak marah, aku cuma penat
Penat yang tak boleh dibayar

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Kalau esok aku lalu sini
Dan kedai ini jadi milik orang
Aku akan berhenti sekejap
Dan ucap terima kasih

[Chorus]
Biar gelap, aku tak lari
Biar habis, aku tak menyesal
Setiap pinggan yang pernah kubasuh
Ada nama anak-anakku di situ

[Outro]
Selamat tinggal
Selamat tinggal

tracks.title: 末班車還有人
tracks.subject: the last train
tracks.caption: A Mandarin pop ballad. Grand piano carries the verses alone, a string section enters at the pre-chorus and swells under the chorus. A male baritone sings restrained and close-miked in the verses, then opens up with full chest voice on the chorus. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb on the vocal, no drums until the second verse where brushed kit enters softly. Slow, 68 BPM, F major. Melancholy but warm, not bleak.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Piano]

[Verse 1]
月台的燈比人還多
最後一班車慢慢靠站
你說再等等
等到什麼我沒有問

[Pre-Chorus]
廣播念完最後一站
風從隧道那頭吹過來

[Chorus]
末班車還有人
只是不再有你
我把座位空著
像留一個從不會來的約

[Verse 2]
手機亮了又暗了
是廣告不是你
窗外的城市倒著走
我也想跟著退回去

[Bridge - strings]
如果那年我留下
如果那晚我說出口
這班車會不會
就不用開這麼久

[Chorus]
末班車還有人
只是不再有你
我把座位空著
像留一個從不會來的約

[Outro]
門要關了
我還坐著
